description_en: Retrieves the XML configuration of a playbook
description_zh: 用于获取剧本的xml配置信息
name: DescribePlaybook

parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the playbook.

Call the [DescribePlaybooks](~~DescribePlaybooks~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
剧本的UUID。
调用[DescribePlaybooks](~~DescribePlaybooks~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: playbook_uuid

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. The default value is zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The MD5 value of the playbook configuration
parameters.name: taskflow_md5

parameters.help_en:
A flag that indicates whether the version is a published version or a debug version. Valid values:

1: retrieves the debug version.

0: retrieves the published version
parameters.help_zh:
线上版本与调试版本的标记，取值：

1：表示获取调试版本
0：表示获取线上发布版本
parameters.name: debug_flag

DisplayName.description_en: The display name of the playbook

FailExeNum.description_en: The number of times the playbook failed to run

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the playbook was created. This is a 13-digit timestamp
GmtCreate.description_zh: 剧本的创建时间，格式：13位的时间戳

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the playbook was last modified. This is a 13-digit timestamp
GmtModified.description_zh: 剧本的修改时间，格式：13位的时间戳

InputParams.description_en:
The input parameter configuration of the playbook. The value is a JSONArray string.

For more information about the format, see [DescribePlaybookInputOutput](~~DescribePlaybookInputOutput~~)
InputParams.description_zh:
剧本的入参配置，为JSONArray格式。
参考[DescribePlaybookInputOutput](~~DescribePlaybookInputOutput~~)接口的格式说明

LastExeTime.description_en: The last time when the playbook was run. This is a 13-digit timestamp
LastExeTime.description_zh: 剧本的最后运行时间，格式：13位的时间戳

OnlineActive.description_en:
A flag that indicates whether the playbook is enabled. Valid values:

0: The playbook is disabled.

1: The playbook is enabled
OnlineActive.description_zh:
剧本的启停标记，取值：

0：表示剧本已停止
1：表示剧本已启用

OnlineReleaseTaskflowMd5.description_en: The MD5 value of the latest published version of the playbook
OnlineReleaseTaskflowMd5.description_zh: 剧本最新发布版本的MD5值

OwnType.description_en:
The type of the playbook. Valid values:

preset: predefined playbook.

user: custom playbook
OwnType.description_zh:
剧本的类型，取值：

preset：预定义剧本。
user：自定义剧本

SuccessExeNum.description_en: The number of times the playbook was successfully run

TaskflowType.description_en:
The configuration format of the playbook.

xml: XML format.

x6: JSON format
TaskflowType.description_zh:
剧本的配置格式。
xml：XML格式。
x6：JSON格式

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. This is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
